_note: Candidate registry for Montana 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Montana Secretary of State, Candidate Filing, Candidate List, FEDERAL GENERAL 2026 (11/03/2026) (General), Export to CSV (272 candidates, retrieved 2026-10-16), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Montana Secretary of State, Candidate Filing, Candidate List, FEDERAL GENERAL 2026 (11/03/2026) (General), Export to CSV (272 candidates, retrieved 2026-10-16) (https://candidatefiling.mt.gov/candidatefiling/CandidateList.aspx?e=450002987); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
